description: Work out gross overtime pay from a base hourly rate and hours worked at three multipliers: standard (1x), time and a half (1.5x) and double time (2x). At least one hours figure is required. Returns pay at each rate, the total and total hours. Gross pay in GBP, before tax and NI. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/overtime-pay-calculator/
